before.finding: Sequential artifact scan evaluated the RLS grant subplan for 2,045 rows and a duplicate explicit grant subplan for 1,000 authorized rows before top-N sorting.

after.finding: The SECURITY DEFINER function validates live tenant/actor scope, materializes only owner or positive unexpired grant IDs, excludes inactive artifacts, limits to 20, then joins publication metadata.

singleEndToEndRetest.interpretation: The shared lab was contended: both the changed catalog path and unchanged admission control regressed together. The isolated query improvement is real, but the end-to-end 250 ms gate remains failed. No opportunistic rerun was used.
